item.title: Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates
item.description:
Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates

Apple has announced that its next generation of software updates, first unveiled at WWDC26, will be released on Monday, September 14. These updates will be available as free downloads for compatible devices across the Apple ecosystem.

⚙️ Key details

The updates introduce major upgrades including design refinements, performance improvements, and updates to various apps. A primary focus of the release is the introduction of new Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features.

Operating System Key Features and Improvements
iOS 27 Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, Visual Intelligence, expanded customization, and upgrades to Photos, Safari, Messages, Mail, Passwords, Shortcuts, and Home
iPadOS 27 Apple Intelligence features and iPad-specific productivity improvements
macOS 27 Golden Gate Siri AI, Visual Intelligence, Apple Intelligence features, and performance improvements
watchOS 27 New Siri, fitness, health, and Smart Stack capabilities

🚀 Availability

In addition to the major operating systems, Apple is releasing tvOS 27, visionOS 27, HomePod software 27, and new AirPods firmware on September 14. Following developer betas in June and public betas in July, users can install the updates via the following methods:

  • iPhone and iPad: Settings > General > Software Update
  • Mac: System Settings > General > Software Update
  • Apple Watch: Through the Watch app on a paired iPhone
  • Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro: Through Settings

#Apple #iOS27 #AppleIntelligence #SiriAI #SoftwareUpdate

Source: Apple confirms release dates for iOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27 and more

item.title: Apple Introduces Siri Audio Intelligence Features with On‑Device Privacy Protections
item.description:
Apple Introduces Siri Audio Intelligence Features with On‑Device Privacy Protections

Apple announced a handful of new Siri AI Audio Intelligence features — Siri Recap, Live Rewind, Sound Recognition, and Music Recognition — at the iPhone Duo launch event, accompanied by a privacy‑focused technical document.

🔍 Overview

  • Siri Recap – summarizes recent interactions.
  • Live Rewind – lets users double‑tap the Digital Crown to replay recent audio.
  • Sound Recognition – identifies ambient sounds.
  • Music Recognition – detects music playing nearby.

🧩 How it works

  • Audio is captured by the microphone and immediately routed into the Secure Enclave of the S11 chip found in Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.
  • The Secure Enclave is a hardware‑isolated compartment that processes sensor data separately from the rest of the system.
  • Within the Enclave, audio is analyzed for speech, sounds, or music without transcribing or storing the raw audio.
  • Processed data lives in a continuously overwritten buffer that never creates an audio recording and is not saved as a file.
  • If results need to move to an iPhone, they are encrypted and transferred through the Secure Enclaves of both devices.

⚙️ Key details

  • The raw audio is not accessible to the operating system, apps, or Apple.
  • Users control when Audio Intelligence features are active; for example, Live Rewind requires a double‑tap of the Digital Crown each time.
  • Users decide what text to keep from Siri Recap and Live Rewind.
  • Kept text syncs with end‑to‑end encryption when a device passcode and iCloud two‑factor authentication are enabled.
  • Apple states it cannot access users’ raw audio from these features.

#Apple #Siri #AudioIntelligence #Privacy

Source: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup
item.description:
Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup

At the “Surprise and Shine” event in Cupertino on September 9, Apple officially unveiled a new generation of hardware, including its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. AI serves as the common thread across this new ecosystem.

📱 iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable iPhone, featuring a Grade 5 titanium build and a precision-engineered hinge with more than 100 components.

  • Displays: A 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display (more than 50% larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max) and a 5.4-inch external display.
  • Durability: IP68 rating and Ceramic Shield 2 on the outer display, which Apple claims has up to three times greater scratch resistance than the previous generation.
  • Performance: Powered by the A20 Pro chip, utilizing a dual-battery architecture and a vapor-chamber cooling system.
  • Display Tech: Supports ProMotion and Always-On capabilities with a peak outdoor brightness of 3,000 nits.
  • Expanded Utility: Support for Apple Pencil USB-C is coming later this year for sketching, note-taking, and document annotation.

📸 iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max

These models focus on AI, battery life, performance, and camera capabilities, powered by the A20 Pro chip and a new-generation vapor-chamber cooling system for high sustained performance.

  • Camera System: Features a 48MP Fusion main camera with variable aperture. The system can automatically optimize aperture for depth of field and lighting, or users can manually select from four levels.
  • Video and Audio: Supports 4K Dolby Vision HDR time-lapse and cinematic effects applied after recording at up to 60 fps. Audio Mix has been improved for voice processing.
  • Imaging: Additional Photographic Styles controls for image grain and texture.

⌚ Apple Watch Series 12

Powered by the S11 chip, the Series 12 introduces a Health Sensing System combining electrical and optical sensors to measure heart rate variability (HRV) and heart rate every five seconds.

  • AI Integration: watchOS 27 brings Siri AI to the device to combine personal context with broader knowledge. New Audio Intelligence capabilities will arrive later this year.
  • Materials: Available in aluminum, titanium, and a ceramic option (available in Night and Pearl White).

⚙️ Key Details

Product Colors Storage / Materials Price / Availability
iPhone Duo Star White, Night Sky 256GB to 2TB Starts at $1,999; Sales Oct 23
iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max Black, Silver, Glacier, Burgundy N/A Retail availability Sept 18

🚀 Availability

  • iPhone Duo: Pre-orders begin October 16; sales start October 23. Available in more than 70 countries, including Vietnam.
  • iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max: Pre-orders begin September 12; retail availability starts September 18. Vietnam is included in first-wave pre-orders.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #iPhone18Pro #AppleWatch #AI

Source: Apple Unveils New Product Lineup: Foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5 - TechTimes.vn

item.title: Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant for Productivity and Personal Tasks
item.description:
Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant for Productivity and Personal Tasks

Meta has launched Muse, its first foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company describes the AI agent as a tool designed to “take the busywork off your plate” by assisting with tasks such as emails, trip-planning, and online shopping.

🧩 How it works

Muse operates using a cloud-based virtual computer to carry out actions. To function, the agent requires permissions to access third-party accounts; for example, connecting to a Google account allows Muse to access, read, and delete emails.

⚙️ Key details

Muse includes a variety of generative and organizational capabilities:

  • Content Generation: Creates images, videos, AI podcasts, and interactive documents or webpages called “artifacts”.
  • Information Retrieval: A “Feed” tab that generates news summaries based on text prompts.
  • Organization: Maintains a running list of “goals” to complete and a list of personalized “ideas” for tool usage.
  • Personalization: Can provide side-by-side product comparisons and track Pokémon card releases.
Feature Capability
Online Shopping Can pick out and purchase items based on size, style, and color
Email Management Can delete promotional emails and updates
Subscriptions Can find and cancel forgotten subscriptions

💡 Why it matters

Tests of the tool reveal varying results regarding safety and data access. Muse refused to generate images of an “Apple CEO” or specific cartoon characters, yet it successfully generated images and video of a product launch event featuring Apple’s logo and device hallucinations.

Regarding privacy, Meta states it does not share information with advertisers and only exchanges data with third-party apps that is “needed for them to work for you.” However, Muse demonstrated the ability to access API data from connected Instagram and Facebook accounts to surface specific user interests not visible in the app’s UI, and it identified a user’s current location using a shipping address from an Amazon order.

#Meta #Muse #AIagents #Productivity

Source: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
